marine_heatwave.intensity: signed SST minus smoothed seasonal mean; event spans include observed bridged days
marine_heatwave.leap_day: interpolate climatology and percentile between February 28 and March 1 before smoothing

thermal_season.threshold: midpoint of smoothed climatological minimum and maximum
thermal_season.cycle: cool minimum before expected warm peak to next occurrence of cool minimum; year labels expected peak
thermal_season.ties: first calendar slot; strict threshold crossings
thermal_season.multiple_cycle_policy: reject baseline with more than one persistent warm run separated by a persistent cool run

coastal.ocean_aggregation: fixed-member area-weighted mean before percentile calculation

particulate.calendar: date-aligned; not identical daily observation windows
particulate.land_assignment: containing native CPC cell; no nearest-valid substitution
